ontology: driftwave_standing_rules — append-only failure-mode memory. Every entry was earned by a real methodology catch; the review stage checks new findings against every rule. New catches are appended by a human git commit to this file (project-local catches can accumulate in the project's .dw/standing_rules.local.json, which the review stage should also read when present). Rules are never deleted, only superseded with a pointer.

rules.rule: Never gate on a significance test without an effect-size floor. Significant and negligible can be the same number.
rules.origin: market-spectral: the pre-registered gate printed PASS (perm p=0.004) on an effect that was 0.09% of rank variance; the robustness pass correctly overturned it to NULL.

rules.rule: Check split-half / subgroup / temporal sign stability before calling any finding PASS. A sign that flips across halves is noise wearing a p-value.
rules.origin: market-spectral: full-sample partial Spearman +0.030 hid a first-half -0.019 / second-half +0.092 flip; 4 of 11 years negative.

rules.rule: Every claim names the cheapest baseline it beats, or carries 'none identified' as a red flag. Incremental-over-baseline is the honest bar.
rules.origin: market-spectral PREREG.md baselines section; potential-map's per-lens null baselines (DMD vs random walk, realized vol vs persistence).

rules.rule: Gates are on instrument correctness; findings are reported as found. A gate failure invalidates the run; a finding never gates, and a null finding ships with a green build.
rules.origin: cocycle verify_launch.py: 'Gates are on INSTRUMENT correctness… correlation values are findings and are reported as found' — how a certified null shipped honestly.

rules.rule: Decision criteria are frozen before measurement, with both branches pre-committed; divergence is disclosed at the point of deviation, never silently.
rules.origin: C1PO promotion_preregistration.json (a FAILED promotion recorded honestly); market-spectral experiment.py DEVIATION NOTE; sha256-research-suite prereg discipline.

rules.rule: Negative results are permanent first-class artifacts. A retry requires a NEW pre-registration — never deletion, never quiet re-running until it passes.
rules.origin: C1PO excess-drift selection.json ('selected': null, kept); driftwave's own dw-bench negative (H0 did not beat Louvain/Ward), kept in-repo.

rules.rule: Agreement is not verification. Exploratory signals that look good never certify anything; only gates actually passed do. Explore-tier output is force-stamped not_acceptance.
rules.origin: ToeStub firewall.py: explore looks promising + certify gates fail => reject; the near-miss doctrine.

rules.rule: Unknown never certifies; fail closed. A missing field, an absent registry, an unset count — each rejects, none passes by default.
rules.origin: ToeStub/C1PO firewall semantics: 'unspecified' satisfies no family; None is not zero; missing registry = safe failure.

rules.rule: Design measurements so they cannot be trivially clean: ask what value a check takes on degenerate input, and if success is indistinguishable from that, add an independent second measurement.
rules.origin: potential-map hodge_lens: naive curl on a scalar surface is 0 by construction, so K-slope and T-slope are fit independently to make disagreement detectable.

rules.rule: Anything that extrapolates or forecasts stamps an out-of-sample comparison against a naive baseline, and auto-downgrades itself to descriptive-only when it loses.
rules.origin: potential-map: every DMD run prints its OOS/random-walk ratio; NFLX 3.01 => auto-labeled descriptive-only.

falsified.approach: Presenting H0 clustering on the default [size_bytes, staleness_days, language-hash] basis as load-bearing structure evidence.
falsified.refutation: dw-bench (experiments/structure-recovery): an honest negative — H0 clustering did not beat Louvain/Ward at recovering real repository structure from git history.
falsified.consequence: L1 output is a descriptive map. compute_persistence.py now says so in-band (caveat field); richer domain-adapter features may change this, but only a new benchmark run can.

falsified.refutation: /tmp is wiped on reboot and shared across projects — the 0.1.x meta-persistence and directive-log memory claims were structurally unfulfillable.
falsified.consequence: All state lives in the per-project .dw/ directory (see driftwave.pin.json state block).

falsified.approach: Jittered tight groups recovered exactly by the median-bar-lifetime cut.
falsified.refutation: dw_selftest.py development: most merge distances are intra-group, so the median lands inside the intra distribution and jittered groups fragment (G2 originally failed 0/3).
falsified.consequence: Exact recovery is asserted on an exact planted distance matrix; jittered fixtures test validity/aliveness/decoy only. Documented in docs/HARNESS.md.
